name: Smash and Grab (Zahya Sadeghi)
author: tabletop-format fixture
notes: Mono-Criminal + neutral toolbox, sample Runner deck for the netrunner-sg fixture. 43 rows total (1 identity + 42 deck cards; minimum_deck_size for this identity is 40 non-identity cards -- see the same identity-slot note as the Corp decklist). Icebreaker suite covers all three types the hard way (Marjanah/Fracter, Carmen/Killer, Mayfly/AI as a decoder-substitute) plus a splash of 3x Buzzsaw (Anarch Decoder, 1 influence each = 3 of 15 available) for real code-gate coverage. Does not include Cleaver, which is BANNED as of restrictions/standard-2026-08.yaml even though it would otherwise be a fine in-faction-adjacent Fracter.
